_what: Labels the owner has ruled on that the camera reference disagrees with. scripts/mai_camera_raw.py applies these AFTER the camera pass and the gold-passage splice, locating each turn by its words (scripts/lib_locate.py), and refuses to write if a text cannot be found or matches more than three blocks.
_why_it_exists: The camera is the best speaker evidence in this repo, but it is not the owner. When a recorded owner decision and the camera disagree, the owner decides, and their ruling has to survive every future rebuild -- an owner decision that lives only in a commit message gets destroyed later. See data/speaker_adjudications.json, ep61_farhan_restore.
